mapper.sql: b.id, b.user_id, b.product_id, b.browse_time, b.create_by, b.update_by, b.create_time, b.update_time, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.main_image, (SELECT MIN(s.product_price) FROM shop_product_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.is_deleted = 0) AS product_price, cat.category_name, u.nickname, u.username

FROM shop_consumer_browse b LEFT JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = b.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_category cat ON cat.id = p.category_id AND cat.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = b.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_consumer_browse SET browse_time = #{browseTime}, is_deleted = 0, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
